title: AuraMind
short_description: AI flashcards + FSRS spaced repetition. Study smarter, not longer.
full_description: AuraMind — the flagship study platform from CogniVect, Inc. Built for students who want to study smarter, not longer. No third-party trackers; your data stays under your control. Visit cogniavect.app to learn about the broader family. © CogniVect, Inc.
